error.message: Conditional statements should always return on the next line
`if`, `for`, `guard`, `switch`, `while`, and `catch` statements shouldn't unnecessarily wrap their conditionals or arguments in parentheses
Prefer checking `isEmpty` over comparing `count` to zero
`where` clauses are preferred over a single `if` inside a `for`
Function should have 5 parameters or less: it currently has 7
Line should be 120 characters or less; currently it has 127 characters
MARK comment should be in valid format. e.g. '// MARK: ...' or '// MARK: - ...'
Operators should be surrounded by a single whitespace when they are being used
Lines should not have trailing semicolons
